description: Passive Modbus/TCP request-response observations decoded from packet captures. Requested write values are retained; read-response values and raw PDUs are intentionally excluded from v1.

direction.notes: Traffic to the configured port is a request; traffic from it is a response. No role inference is presented as discovered device identity.

fields.name: timestamp
fields.description: Timestamp of the packet that completed the first observed ADU for this transaction.

fields.name: unit_id
fields.description: Modbus unit identifier; important when a TCP endpoint fronts multiple downstream devices.

fields.name: address
fields.description: Primary zero-based protocol address when the request function carries one.

fields.name: coil_values
fields.description: Requested coil values in address order for functions 5 and 15. The base is address. Null means not applicable or not decoded; presence records requested intent, not confirmed application.

fields.name: register_values
fields.description: Requested unsigned 16-bit register values in address order for functions 6, 16, and 23. The base is address, except function 23 uses write_address. Null means not applicable or not decoded; presence records requested intent, not confirmed application.

fields.name: request_packet
fields.description: One-based capture packet number in which the request ADU became decodable.

fields.name: response_packet
fields.description: One-based capture packet number in which the response ADU became decodable.

fields.name: parser_warning
fields.description: Semicolon-delimited, machine-stable parser caveats attached to this observation.
